stage_question: Does each frozen survey have actual FNV swath-line navigation support near the exact ROV-groundtruth location, beyond coarse footprint polygons?
inputs_allowed: port and starboard swath edge coordinates

frozen_support_tiers.DIRECT_FNV_SWATH_LINE_SUPPORT: minimum point-to-port-starboard ping segment distance <= 100 m
frozen_support_tiers.NO_LOCAL_FNV_SUPPORT: minimum distance >1000 m or no parseable FNV rows

hard_rules: This gate tests navigation/swath support only.
FNV swath-line proximity is not itself a morphology detection.
No survey is dropped because it gives an inconvenient support result.
EX1903L2 remains groundtruth-era and cannot tune the detector.
After this gate, detector scales remain chosen from native resolution before truth scoring.
next_if_supported: Freeze target-hidden search windows and native-resolution scale ladders, then run EX1203 discovery without reading ROV truth during scoring code.
